a: 5-year Associate Staff Scientist appointment with research support; review for continuing staff at or before the end.
dt: SLAC says the 2027 call will be 'announced by late September' with a deadline 'anticipated to be in mid-November' 2026. The 2026 deadline was 2025-11-14.
e: Early-career PhDs; postdoc experience not strictly required. Fields across the SLAC mission, including particle physics and astrophysics.
